rows.question: List the names of all artists whose name starts with 'The'.
rows.raw_output: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE Name LIKE 'The%';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE Name LIKE 'The%' ORDER BY Name;

rows.question: What is the email address of the customer named Luís Gonçalves?
rows.raw_output: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Luís' AND LastName = 'Gonçalves';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Luís' AND LastName = 'Gonçalves';

rows.question: List all track names that are longer than 300000 milliseconds.
rows.raw_output: SELECT Track.Name FROM Track WHERE Track.Milliseconds > 300000;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY Name;

rows.question: Which employees have the job title 'Sales Support Agent'?
rows.raw_output: SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY LastName;

rows.question: List all customers who live in Brazil.
rows.raw_output: SELECT [FirstName], [LastName] FROM [Customer] WHERE [Country] = 'Brazil';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY LastName;

rows.question: What are the names of all genres?
rows.raw_output: SELECT Name FROM Genre;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name;

rows.question: List all playlists that have 'Music' in their name.
rows.raw_output: SELECT PlaylistId FROM Playlist WHERE Name LIKE '%Music%';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Playlist WHERE Name LIKE '%Music%';

rows.question: Find the track named 'Balls to the Wall'.
rows.raw_output: SELECT TrackId, Name, AlbumId, GenreId, MediaTypeId, Composer FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Balls to the Wall';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name, Composer, Milliseconds FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Balls to the Wall';

rows.question: List customers from the state of California (CA).
rows.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE State = 'CA' ORDER BY LastName;

rows.question: What is the postal code of the employee named Andrew Adams?
rows.raw_output: SELECT Email FROM Employee WHERE LastName = 'Adams' AND FirstName = 'Andrew';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT PostalCode FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams';

rows.question: How many tracks are there in total?
rows.raw_output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track;

rows.question: How many customers are there from Germany?
rows.raw_output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Germany';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Germany';

rows.question: What is the total number of invoices?
rows.raw_output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice;

rows.question: What is the average unit price of a track?
rows.raw_output: SELECT AVG(Track.UnitPrice) FROM Track;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track;

rows.question: What is the total sum of all invoice totals?
rows.raw_output: `SELECT SUM(Invoice.Total) FROM Invoice;`
rows.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;

rows.question: How many distinct countries do customers come from?
rows.raw_output: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer;

rows.question: How many albums does the artist with ArtistId 1 have?
rows.raw_output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album WHERE ArtistId = 1;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album WHERE ArtistId = 1;

rows.question: What is the longest track duration in milliseconds?
rows.raw_output: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM Track;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM Track;

rows.question: What is the shortest track duration in milliseconds, excluding zero?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 0;

rows.question: How many tracks belong to the genre 'Rock'?
rows.raw_output: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track INNER JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Rock';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock';

rows.question: List the names of all albums by the artist 'AC/DC'.
rows.raw_output: SELECT Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

rows.question: List the track names on the album 'Facelift'.
rows.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE al.Title = 'Facelift';

rows.question: Which genre does the track 'Fast As a Shark' belong to?
rows.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE t.Name = 'Fast As a Shark';

rows.question: List the first and last names of customers along with the city of their support representative.
rows.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, e.City AS RepCity FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId;

rows.question: List the first 20 track names along with their media type name.
rows.raw_output:
```sql
SELECT Track.Name, MediaType.Name
FROM Track
INNER JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
LIMIT 20;
```
rows.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, m.Name AS MediaType FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY t.Name LIMIT 20;

rows.question: List the names of the first 20 tracks in the playlist called 'Music'.
rows.raw_output: SELECT Name FROM Track INNER JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Track.TrackId = PlaylistTrack.TrackId INNER JOIN Playlist ON PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId = Playlist.PlaylistId WHERE Playlist.Name = 'Music' LIMIT 20;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music' ORDER BY pt.TrackId LIMIT 20;

rows.question: What is the total amount billed to each customer named 'Frank Harris'?
rows.raw_output:
```sql
SELECT SUM(Invoice.Total) as TotalBilled
FROM Invoice
JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId
WHERE Customer.FirstName = 'Frank' AND Customer.LastName = 'Harris';
```
rows.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalBilled FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName='Frank' AND c.LastName='Harris' GROUP BY c.CustomerId;

rows.question: List the names of employees and the first names of the employees they report to.
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Employee.Name, ReportingEmployee.FirstName FROM Employee
JOIN Employee ReportingEmployee ON Employee.ReportsTo = ReportingEmployee.EmployeeId;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT e1.FirstName AS Employee, e2.FirstName AS Manager FROM Employee e1 JOIN Employee e2 ON e1.ReportsTo = e2.EmployeeId;

rows.question: List all invoice lines for the track named 'Right Next Door to Hell', showing quantity and unit price.
rows.raw_output:
SELECT InvoiceLine.Quantity, InvoiceLine.UnitPrice
   FROM InvoiceLine
   INNER JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
   WHERE Track.Name = 'Right Next Door to Hell';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT il.Quantity, il.UnitPrice FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.Name = 'Right Next Door to Hell';

rows.question: List the album title and artist name for the track 'Go Down'.
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Album.Title, Artist.Name
   FROM Track
   JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
   JOIN Artist ON Track.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
   WHERE Track.Name = 'Go Down';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, ar.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE t.Name = 'Go Down';

rows.question: For each country, how many customers are there? Order by count descending.
rows.raw_output: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) as CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY NumCustomers DESC;

rows.question: For each genre, how many tracks are there? Order by genre name.
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) as TrackCount
   FROM Genre
   JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId
   GROUP BY Genre.Name
   ORDER BY Genre.Name;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY g.Name;

rows.question: Which countries have more than 5 customers?
rows.raw_output: SELECT City, Country FROM Customer GROUP BY City, Country HAVING COUNT(CustomerId) > 5;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY NumCustomers DESC;

rows.question: For each artist, how many albums do they have? Show only artists with more than 5 albums.
rows.raw_output:
```sql
SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) as NumberOfAlbums
FROM Artist
JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId
GROUP BY Artist.Name
HAVING COUNT(Album.AlbumId) > 5;
```
rows.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 5 ORDER BY NumAlbums DESC;

rows.question: What is the total sales amount for each employee (by their supported customers' invoices)?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Employee.LastName, Employee.FirstName, SUM(Invoice.Total) as TotalSales
   FROM Employee
   JOIN Customer ON Employee.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId
   JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId
   GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId, Employee.LastName, Employee.FirstName;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSales FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;

rows.question: For each media type, how many tracks use it?
rows.raw_output: SELECT MediaTypeId, COUNT(TrackId) as TrackCount FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name ORDER BY NumTracks DESC;

rows.question: Which playlists have more than 500 tracks?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack
JOIN Playlist ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId
GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId
HAVING COUNT(PlaylistTrack.TrackId) > 500;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.Name HAVING COUNT(pt.TrackId) > 500 ORDER BY NumTracks DESC;

rows.question: For each billing country, what is the total invoice amount?
rows.raw_output:
```sql
SELECT Country, SUM(Total) as TotalInvoiceAmount
FROM Invoice
JOIN Customer ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId
GROUP BY Country;
```
rows.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC;

rows.question: How many albums does each artist have? Show only artists with exactly 1 album.
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) as NumberOfAlbums
   FROM Artist
   JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId
   GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId
   HAVING COUNT(Album.AlbumId) = 1;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) = 1 ORDER BY ar.Name;

rows.question: What is the average track length in milliseconds for each genre?
rows.raw_output:
```sql
SELECT Genre.Name, AVG(Track.Milliseconds) as AverageLength
FROM Genre
JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId
GROUP BY Genre.Name;
```
rows.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS AvgLength FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY AvgLength DESC;

rows.question: What are the 5 most expensive tracks?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT TrackId, Name, UnitPrice
   FROM Track
   ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC
   LIMIT 5;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 5;

rows.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT [FirstName], [LastName], [Email] FROM [Customer]
JOIN (
    SELECT [CustomerId], SUM([UnitPrice] * [Quantity]) as TotalSpend
    FROM [InvoiceLine]
    GROUP BY [CustomerId]
) as TotalSpends
ON [CustomerId] = TotalSpends.[CustomerId]
ORDER BY TotalSpends.TotalSpend DESC
LIMIT 3;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 3;

rows.question: What are the 10 longest tracks by duration?
rows.raw_output: SELECT TrackId, Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10;

rows.question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) as TrackCount
FROM Genre
JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId
GROUP BY Genre.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 5;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY NumTracks DESC LIMIT 5;

rows.question: What are the 3 best-selling tracks by total quantity sold?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT TrackId, Name, SUM(Quantity) as TotalQuantitySold
   FROM InvoiceLine
   JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
   GROUP BY TrackId, Name
   ORDER BY TotalQuantitySold DESC
   LIMIT 3;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS TotalSold FROM Track t JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId ORDER BY TotalSold DESC LIMIT 3;

rows.question: Which artist has the most albums?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Artist.Name
    FROM Artist
    JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId
    GROUP BY Artist.Name
    ORDER BY COUNT(Album.AlbumId) DESC
    LIMIT 1;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY NumAlbums DESC LIMIT 1;

rows.question: What are the 5 most recent invoices by date?
rows.raw_output: SELECT * FROM Invoice ORDER BY InvoiceDate DESC LIMIT 5;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice ORDER BY InvoiceDate DESC LIMIT 5;

rows.question: Which 5 customers have the most invoices?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(InvoiceId) as NumberOfInvoices
FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId
GROUP BY CustomerId
ORDER BY NumberOfInvoices DESC
LIMIT 5;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS NumInvoices FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY NumInvoices DESC LIMIT 5;

rows.question: List the names of the first 20 tracks that have never appeared on any invoice, ordered alphabetically.
rows.raw_output:
SELECT Name FROM Track
   LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId
   WHERE InvoiceLine.TrackId IS NULL
   ORDER BY Name ASC
   LIMIT 20;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine) ORDER BY Name LIMIT 20;

rows.question: Which customers have spent more than the average total per invoice?
rows.raw_output:
SELECT CustomerId
FROM Invoice
JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId
GROUP BY CustomerId
HAVING SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice);
rows.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice) ORDER BY c.LastName;

rows.question: List all invoices billed in the year 2021.
rows.raw_output: SELECT InvoiceId, InvoiceDate FROM Invoice WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2021';
rows.gold_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY InvoiceDate;

rows.question: What distinct billing countries appear in the invoices?
rows.raw_output: SELECT DISTINCT BillingCountry FROM Invoice;
rows.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT BillingCountry FROM Invoice ORDER BY BillingCountry;

rows.question: List artists who have no albums in the database.
rows.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ArtistId FROM Album);
